nom: Vichy Pureté Thermale Mineral Micellar Water for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the product removes makeup and oil without leaving a greasy film, and one double-cleanses because her skin is 'super oily' and finds it merely adequate rather than essential.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers mostly report it does not strip or tighten their skin and leaves it hydrated, though one with 'very dry skin' still found it slightly drying and needed to moisturize right after.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as suitable for daily use, cleansing oil and dirt without stripping moisture.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most vocal group, repeatedly reporting no burning, stinging, or redness, including one who says other removers always leave her 'beet red and burning' but this one does not, though one reviewer specifically warns the 'sensitive skin' formula still contains added fragrance.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry or sensitive skin, report their face feels hydrated, soft, or 'plump' afterward and not stripped; one reviewer with very dry skin is the exception, noting it still felt slightly drying for her.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers with reactive, redness-prone skin report calm skin and no flushing or burning after use, in contrast to other makeup removers they had tried.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-irritating even with daily double use, with no reports of compromised or reactive skin from use itself.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin mostly report it does not cause new breakouts and even feels balancing when paired with drying acne treatments; one reviewer notes it did not help prevent her hormonal breakouts, and another had ongoing 'bad acne' that only cleared gradually with combined use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report a clean, non-greasy finish, but a couple describe the product itself feeling 'oily and greasy' on their skin, and one felt 'less clean' and greasy the next morning after nighttime use.

extraits.texte: More perfume !!! In the Sensitivity formula! No wonder people need eczema meds! It's in everything!! Ridiculous!

extraits.titre: Removes Makeup Easily, Works Great w/ My Sensitive
extraits.texte: I really enjoyed using this product. It definitely removed my makeup with ease - I soaked a cotton ball and wiped softly away as described on the instructions and I was surprised with how easily my makeup was removed without having to continuously scrub! Especially with my overnight caked-on mascara and eyeliner. I also have very sensitive skin and eyes, but I didn't experience any discomfort while using this product. The only fault I would mention, which also brought me to use the 4-star rating, is that it was a bit drying on my skin. However, I have very dry skin as is, and even plain water will dry me out if I don't instantly moisturize. Overall, I would recommend others to use this product, especially if they are looking for something to remove makeup easily without scrubbing and if they have sensitive skin and/or eyes. I am happy with the product and will continue using for sure!

extraits.titre: The best cleanser for sensitive and acne proneskin
extraits.texte: I love this micellar water. I use it to cleanse my face because I cannot use any type of face wash. This does not strip my skin or cause irritation like other cleansers or micellar water products. It actually leaves my skin feeling soft after use. I have always had bad acne. I use this morning and night before applying my acne products and lotin. I can say that this is the only thing that doesn't strip my skin and actually seems to keep it hydrated and balanced when combined with drying and irritating products. It's a little pricey, but absolutely worth it.

I found the vichy micellar water to be a great addition to my skincare routine. It easily removes makeup and dirt from my skin. I have very sensitive skin and experienced no redness or adverse effects from its use. I do experience hormonal acne close to "shark week," and this product didn't help prevent it at all (but I also wasn't expecting it to). Overall I was extremely pleased and will purchase it in the future.

I have insanely sensitive skin that gets so red and flushed regardless of what product I use. Any makeup remover wipe I try always leaves me beet red and burning. Vichy completely cleaned my skin and removed all my make up without scrubbing but more importantly without any burning or flushed skin! I truly love it!

I love the idea of an easy way to remove makeup and cleanse my skin, but I found this product not very effective. It took just as long to remove my makeup with this as any other method and when I was done I felt less clean. When used before bed, it left my skin feeling greasy the next morning. It didn't make me break out, but I wouldn't continue to use it when there are other equally effective, more comfortable methods for taking care of my face.

Amazing micellar water, simply the best, and I've tried many! It may be that my skin (combination, sensitive, gets dry if I use a foaming wash) gets along well with Vichy, but I just love their products: dercos shampoo, vichy micellar water, aqualia thermal serum, mineral 89 serum.
